summary:
Main
Iron ore futures traded softer today. The DCE most-active contract I2701 settled at RMB 714.0/mt, down 1.11% from theprevious trading day.Spot prices at Qingdao Port fell in step by around RMB 10-13/mt. The pullback in futures dragged spot offers lower, while mills showed stronger willingness to restock on dips, lifting overall trading activity slightly.
